title: German Stew with Herbal Flair
description: A hearty German-inspired stew infused with fresh herbal notes, perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Herbal bouquet
ingredients.amount: 2 sprigs of fresh thyme, 1 sprig of fresh rosemary

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced Pak chilies and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the chopped baby carrots and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to tenderize.
Add the cubed potatoes, diced tomatoes, thyme, and rosemary to the pot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
